findings.title: Telemetry monitor displays fabricated security evidence as live state
findings.evidence: main creates SharedManifest::new locally at line 112; render_screen prints fixed SUPPORTED NEMESIS claims, SEALED attestation (96-100), fixed receipt records (84-87), and ACTIVE hardware gate (35). No receipt or gate evidence is read.
findings.trigger: Run babylon_top, including on a host with no running kernel or attestation evidence.
findings.impact: Operator is shown successful security checks and committed effects that have never been observed.

findings.title: Unimplemented specialists are counted as successful verification
findings.evidence: evaluate_specialist initializes passed=True (362); its catch-all branch only sets a verified message (557-559). main counts those booleans and writes telemetry/zero-failure exit verdict (640-660).
findings.trigger: Any matrix entry without a specific evaluation branch, such as A001.
findings.impact: Audit reports assert verification without checking the claimed invariant; missing implementations increase successful totals.

findings.title: KL computation compares histograms with incompatible bin edges
findings.evidence: np.histogram(point_cloud,bins=50,density=True) and np.histogram(reconstructed_cloud,bins=50,density=True) independently choose edges, then their array indices are compared as the same events.
findings.trigger: Input and reconstructed clouds have different ranges, including translated distributions of the same shape.
findings.impact: Reported KL can hide displaced probability mass or compare unrelated intervals; returned calibration metrics are incorrect.

findings.title: Configured invalid signing seed silently switches identity
findings.evidence: SigningKey(bytes.fromhex(seed)) is wrapped in broad except Exception that generates a fresh SigningKey, and anchor_payload then receives its public key (814).
findings.trigger: A nonempty configured seed is malformed or has wrong length.
findings.impact: Anchoring proceeds under an unexpected ephemeral identity instead of surfacing the signing-configuration error.

findings.title: Crash harness cannot detect committed transactions with zero effects
findings.evidence: Worker commits the database before writing effects.log (191-208). Boundary 5 pauses only after the effect sync (211-213), leaving the commit/effect gap untested. Forensic invariant 2 iterates only effects_after_phase2 (470 onward), not committed ledger rows; replay rejects every COMMITTED nonce before checking its effect (258-262).
findings.trigger: A worker terminates after tx.commit() and before writing its effect, or an effect write fails after the commit.
findings.impact: A committed entry can retain zero effects and replay will not repair it; the claimed committed=>exactly_one_effect audit does not count this loss.
